obligations.summary: Bind N19 exact A as uniform governance without behavior carryover
Preserve D07 uniqueness and optional membership per exact D30 kind
Present uniform reject, uniform allow, defer, and stop only
Keep canonical another-entity wording as recommendation evidence, not verdict
Exclude longer cycles, duplicates, closure, mandatory, representation, feature, runtime, numeric, other relations, and token inference
Provide aligned examples with no decision effect
Stop before N20 selection, Plan, or implementation

promotion, publication, and N20 owner selection
validation_surface: Decision Gate prefilter schemas and request digest
six-view, Distill, dispatch-trace, and complexity-ladder coverage
JSON, whitespace, scoped diff, main packet, and source preservation
